C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified, no design choice

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, clear spec, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a gate or the ledger contract; wrong means every project inherits it

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, anything in a project's real data, a sponsor decision

phases.name: Warm-up standard
phases.goal: One /warmup, one set of templates, one tracker for every focus project, built in common-rules and proven on the PhotoVault engine first (D6).
phases.exit: The five exit conditions in proposal 19 'What completes this', each measured.

items.title: The ledger contract: tools/tracker/ledger.py, bin/tracker validate
items.what: The shared loader every command builds on. Tolerates the engine's existing spellings (files/tests/depends as a string or a list), never rewrites a ledger, validates ids, statuses, classes, dependencies, discovered_from and asks.
items.done: The engine's proposal 71 ledger validates unchanged; every problem class names its item; validate exits 0/1/2.

items.title: templates/ — the six seeds and the brief
items.what: HANDOFF.md, OPERATING-RULES.md, ledger.json, lead-prompt.md, checkpoint.md and brief.md, each with the sections proposal 19 names. The ledger template validates; the brief has OWNS · MUST · MUST NOT · OUTPUT · EFFORT in that order; the lead prompt carries §7 (steps list, one status line, checkpoint before stopping) and the Ruflo loop.
items.done: test_templates asserts every required section of every template and that templates/ledger.json passes ledger.validate.

items.title: bin/tracker render — ledger.json to the proposal page
items.what: Renders a ledger into a readable page: status line, per-phase bars, item table with tags and issue links, open asks, proposed changes. Writes to a separate generated file so a hand-authored proposal page is never overwritten.
items.done: Renders the engine's 71 ledger and this ledger with no hand edits; counts on the page equal ledger.counts; --check exits 1 when the page is older than the ledger.

items.title: bin/tracker check — land refuses a commit whose ledger row did not move
items.what: Reads item ids named in a commit range; refuses when a named item's log has no entry newer than the branch point. Wired into land_one beside the other gates, same opt-in guard, override LAND_ALLOW_UNLOGGED_ITEM.
items.done: Four cases tested: no ledger, compliant, unmoved row refused, override.

items.title: bin/tracker sync — GitHub issues mirror the ledger one way
items.what: For each item: create the issue when it is in progress and has none, label it proposal:NN and tier:<tier>, close it when done, and report drift (issue closed while row open, row done while issue open). gh is called through an injectable runner; --dry-run prints the plan.
items.done: Tests drive a fake gh: creates, labels, closes, reports both drift directions, never writes the ledger except the new issue number, always passes --limit.

items.title: /warmup skill and bin/warmup --check
items.what: The skill reads HANDOFF → OPERATING-RULES → ledger → last checkpoint → CLAUDE-workflow.md, verifies Ruflo, worktree, test command and rulecheck, runs recall for the next items, and prints the warm card; mid-session prints the delta. bin/warmup --check exits 1 when a standard file is missing or stale against HEAD.
items.done: --check exit codes tested on seeded and unseeded projects; the card's counts equal ledger.counts; staleness measured in commits.

items.title: bin/recall and bin/remember
items.what: recall greps every project's memory dir, LESSONS.md, docs/OPERATING-RULES.md and ledger logs under ~/apps and prints path:line (date) per hit, ranked by how many query words match. remember writes one fact file in the memory shape and appends its index line.
items.done: Tests on a scratch tree: hits carry path and line, no hit exits 1, remember refuses a duplicate name and writes valid frontmatter.

items.title: Stop, PreCompact and SessionStart hooks; checkpoint writer
items.what: tools/tracker/checkpoint.py writes docs/handovers/<date>-checkpoint.md from the ledger (count, in progress, blocked, open asks, next unblocked). hooks/precompact and hooks/stop run it; hooks/sessionstart prints the re-warm reminder when source is compact. Each reads the hook JSON on stdin and never fails the session.
items.done: Tests feed each hook its stdin JSON: the checkpoint is written from a scratch ledger, a missing ledger exits 0 with a note, compact vs startup behave differently.

items.title: derecord seeds the templates and installs the hooks
items.what: Seeds any of the six files a project lacks (never overwrites) and installs the three hooks in .claude/settings.json the way the SessionStart rulecheck is installed today.
items.done: Existing derecord tests pass; seeding is idempotent and never touches an existing file.

items.title: /warmup --migrate and tracker import
items.what: Reheat: seed, import an existing plan into a ledger, move superseded rules into a dated block, rewrite the CLAUDE.md pointers, print the superseded list.
items.done: Imports pockets' and finance-tracker's milestone tables into ledgers that validate; nothing removed from OPERATING-RULES, only moved.

items.title: Pilot on the PhotoVault engine; measure the exit conditions
items.what: Run /warmup --migrate in the engine, render its 71 ledger, turn on the gate, and measure proposal 19's five exit conditions from the transcript over the pilot week.
items.done: Each exit condition reported with its measurement.
